device_name: CREO MCS - Midline Cortical Screw System

specs.Features: Detachable/ Modular Head , Polyaxial Head , Medial Cortical Screw

description:
CREO MCS: Midline Cortical Screw System
The CREO MCS system is a minimally invasive solution for pedicle screw placement in the midline cortical approach technique. This is a modular screw platform which is compatible with the CREO AMP polyaxial head. The system has a dual outer diameter thread and tighter thread pitch than traditional pedicle screws.
Screw options:
features: Sizes same as CREO AMP screw
